children: New autonomous Edge AI system combines thermal sensing, AI and local processing, with potential for a follow-on order of more than 1,000 units

NETANYA, Israel, Oct. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Zorronet Ltd. ("Zorronet"), a subsidiary of Tessera Defense and Homeland Security Inc. (NYSE American: HLSQ) ("Tessera" or the "Company") today announced that it has received an initial purchase order from a leading global defense company for a newly developed Edge AI system and according to the customer, subject to successful field testing and performance validation, potential for a follow-on order of up to 1,000 units.

The system was jointly developed to address specific operational requirements defined by the customer. Combining thermal sensing, advanced AI, computer vision and high-performance local processing, it can detect and analyze events in real time and initiate predefined responses directly in the field. The customer ordered two initial units for further testing and demonstration of operational capabilities under field conditions following an initial evaluation of a working prototype.

Designed for deployment in open areas and challenging conditions, the system uses an Edge AI architecture that processes information locally, without relying on cloud services or external servers. This enables rapid decision-making and continued operation when communications are limited or unstable while keeping data processing and system control local.

The system is developed and manufactured in Israel, with Zorronet responsible for the software, integration, assembly, enclosure design and environmental sealing. The joint project demonstrates Zorronet's ability to combine its AI-powered intelligence technologies with physical sensing and computing hardware to engineer complete operational systems tailored to customer requirements.

This initial purchase order is an important step in Zorronet's expanding defense business. Zorronet is progressing from technology demonstrations and prototype development to customer orders for operational systems while broadening its capabilities beyond software integration to deliver complete, customer-specific solutions combining sensing, AI, processing and response.

"What matters to us isn't only the order itself, but the trust behind it," said Idan Wasserman, CEO of Zorronet. "We received a real operational requirement from a company with exceptional technological capabilities and experience. They brought their expertise, we brought our AI and integration capabilities, and together we developed a working solution. To me, that's how technology should be built - working alongside the people at the forefront of their field, understanding the real challenges on the ground, and creating solutions that can improve capabilities and potentially save lives. The first two units are just the beginning. Now it's our job to prove the system in the field."

"This order reflects an important development in Zorronet's capabilities and its role within Tessera," said Michael Oster, CEO of Tessera. "Defense customers increasingly need intelligent systems that can operate independently, process information locally and respond in real time, even when communications are limited. Zorronet's ability to bring together AI, sensing and computing into integrated solutions tailored to specific operational requirements positions it to pursue additional opportunities across defense, homeland security and critical infrastructure."

Zorronet develops tailored AI-powered operational intelligence solutions designed around each organization's unique environment, challenges and operational needs. Zorronet connects existing cameras, sensors and security systems to create a unified operational picture. Combining AI, machine learning, computer vision and vision-language models, Zorronet learns activity patterns, validates information across multiple sources and interprets events in context, transforming complex data into actionable intelligence. Through tailored engineering and system integration, Zorronet enables earlier threat awareness, informed decision-making and coordinated or authorized autonomous responses. Its mission is to make advanced operational intelligence accessible to organizations of different sizes and capabilities, building on their existing infrastructure and resources.
About Tessera Defense and Homeland Security Inc.

Tessera Defense and Homeland Security Inc. (NYSE American: HLSQ) is a physical security technology company providing integrated, bespoke security solutions that connect detection, intelligence and response across complex security environments. The Tessera platform integrates cameras, sensors, detection technologies, AI and other security infrastructure to identify threats, understand events and coordinate response in real time. Tessera provides the technology, hardware and implementation expertise needed to tailor security solutions to the specific requirements of each site, helping customers deploy and optimize integrated security systems across critical infrastructure, energy, digital infrastructure and homeland security applications. For more information, visit https://thlsq.ai/.
